verdict.rationale: The IRS's own Modernized e-File machine interfaces are versioned through per-tax-year XML schema packages, business-rule releases and a versioned developer guide (Pub 4164). Changes are staged in the Assurance Testing System ahead of Production, with advance notice for implementers. However, the evidence explicitly finds no public deprecation-policy document, and version lifecycle detail sits behind the registration-gated e-Services portal. missing for 10: a published deprecation/sunset policy, publicly accessible version lifecycle documentation, public schema/WSDL distribution, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Federal returns must conform to valid schema versions.
Schemas and business rules are now available through the registered user portal and your e-services mailbox

Transmitters, software developers, and state agencies are encouraged to review their implementations and complete any necessary changes in ATS prior to the Production deployment to avoid service disruptions.
